retrievalProfile.description: A cinematic night scene featuring a group of figures in motion next to a stylized road sign, topped with a glowing script logo and wide-spaced yellow sans-serif text.
triggerTerms: retro script logo with yellow subtitle

recipe.visualDefinition: A group of four men in 1970s attire are captured in a dynamic, slightly blurred motion on a dark roadside at night. To their left, a large, stylized triangular warning sign with a red border and a black exclamation mark stands prominently. The top of the frame features a glowing, airbrushed script logo in orange and yellow, followed by a subtitle in wide-tracked, bold yellow sans-serif capitals.
coreVisualRelationships: Figures positioned in a diagonal line receding into the dark background
Bright red road sign acting as a vertical anchor on the left third
Glowing warm-toned typography contrasting against a deep purple-black sky
Motion blur on the figures suggesting urgency or action
coreInvariants: High-contrast nighttime lighting with deep shadows
Triangular warning sign with thick red border

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four figures occupy the center and right foreground, scaled to appear life-sized within the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red and white triangular road sign on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the glowing logo top-left, moves across the yellow text, then follows the diagonal line of the figures down to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep, dark negative space in the upper right and lower left corners emphasizes the subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep purple and black for the night sky and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright red and white for the road sign.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant yellow and orange for the typography and highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the accents against a low-value, desaturated background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy tones for clothing

letterConstructionRules: Primary logo uses a thick, flowing script with heavy airbrushed outlines
Secondary text uses a bold, blocky sans-serif with extreme letter spacing
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script logo features a long horizontal underline extending from the first letter
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Fluid, organic script paired with rigid, spaced-out geometric sans.
graphicDevices: Airbrushed outer glow on main logo

preserve: Extreme tracking on the sans-serif text
The red/white/black color scheme of the sign

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, hand-drawn feel of the 70s logo
Provides the geometric weight needed for the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a nighttime scene of four men in 70s clothing (denim, striped shirts) moving urgently along a dark roadside. Include a large triangular warning sign with a red border and black exclamation mark on the left. Use deep purple and black for the sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, glowing orange script logo in the top left. To its right, add uppercase yellow sans-serif text with very wide letter spacing, tilted slightly upward.

verificationChecks: Is the road sign a prominent red and white triangle?
Is the yellow text spaced out significantly?
Does the main logo have a warm, airbrushed glow?
Is the overall lighting moody and nighttime-focused?

adjustableVariables: Specific text in the logo and subtitle

mustAchieve: Authentic 1970s film grain and color grading

postGenerationChecks: Check that the red sign does not overlap the text
Ensure the yellow text is legible despite the wide tracking
Verify the figures appear to be in motion
Confirm the color palette is dominated by dark tones with bright accents
recipe.reuseFormula: Nighttime roadside photography + 70s fashion + triangular warning sign + glowing script logo + wide-tracked sans-serif subtitle.
